speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Coarctation of the Aorta.

The finding of isolated hypertension in the right upper extremity in an otherwise healthy 5-year-old boy is highly suggestive of a mechanical obstruction to blood flow distal to the subclavian artery. I am requesting images to confirm this.

REQUEST IMAGES: Echocardiogram and Upper Extremity Doppler Ultrasound.
